title: Accounts with a contact and an invoice
prompt: Collections can only chase accounts that have both a contact person and at least one invoice. Write `solve(contacts, invoices)` so it returns the `account_id` of every such account.
rules: An account qualifies when its `account_id` appears in `contacts` and also in `invoices`.
Return one column, `account_id`, with each account once, however many contacts or invoices it has.
Compare ids exactly as they are. A missing id on both sides counts as a match, as in any set operation.
hints: Reduce each table to just its `account_id` column first.
You want the ids that are in both lists.
